system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: Jirayu and one partner applied to register a private limited company with two promoters on 15 December 2022, and applied again with the same composition on 15 March 2023. Which application was permissible and which was not? Answer briefly with reasons.
raw_response:
The application on 15 December 2022 was permissible; the one on 15 March 2023 was not.

Reason: Under Section 1149 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, a person who has previously applied for the registration of a private limited company may not reapply within six months from the date of the prior application. Since both applications had the same composition and were submitted less than six months apart (15 December 2022 to 15 March 2023), the second application violated this rule.
